description:
How many launches win in this category? How long does a new serum take to take off on Amazon Spain?
(¿Cuántos lanzamientos triunfan en esta categoría? ¿Cuánto tarda en despegar un sérum nuevo?)

Wintraits Success Ratio: of every 100, how many win and how many fail, median days to take off, overall and by quarter.
Only groups with 30 launches or more. `cita` has the public URL and the date of the data to cite it.

Args:
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "serums").
    pais: country code (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
name: wintraits_indice_categoria
